scope: Proposition 6.7 (Limits away from affinity) of the manuscript “Positive Metric Entropy for the Standard Map at Large Parameters” (preprints/Positive-Metric-Entropy-for-the-Standard-Map-at-Large-Parameters-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 146 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 35559ad1965dc13f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 32. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: After passing to a subsequence, the restrictions of µK and νK to U converge vaguely to locally finite nonnegative Borel measures µ and ν, respectively. Moreover, ξK −→ 0 vaguely on U. (6.21) The measures µ and ν are supported on the closed class X0 ⊂ X consisting of arrays satisfying d(s, t) ≤ |s − t| and the inequalities Bv(s, t) ≥ min{Bv(s, p), Bv(p, t)}, Bv(s, t) = d(v, s) + d(v, t) − d(s, t) (6.22) for every v, s, t, p ∈ D. Every member of X0 extends uniquely to a continuous semimetric on R, obeying the same inequalities at all real arguments. Both limiting measures are invariant under (τrd)(s, t) = d(s + r, t + r) (r ∈ D). For every interval I as in Theorem 6.5, Z (J(I) + V (I)) dµ < ∞, Z (h(I) + J(I) + V (I)) dν < ∞. (6.23) In particular, Z h([0, 1]) dν ≤ 1. (6.24)
